charge_port.notes: Tesla connector (now NACS / SAE J3400) on every Tesla since the 2012 Model S; Canada and US cars alike (Wikipedia NACS article; EVSpecifications lists "NACS / Tesla (SAE J3400)" on Model S Plaid pages).

supercharger_access.notes: Tesla's own Supercharger network, built for this connector (Wikipedia NACS article); same in Canada and the US.

wheels.notes: 20 inch aluminum standard. Carried over from a neighbouring model year on the same body; that year was not opened.
